arguments.query: SELECT payment_status, COUNT(*) FROM payments GROUP BY 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id), COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.paid_ts < o.paid_ts THEN f.order_id END) FROM payments f JOIN payments o ON o.order_id=f.order_id AND o.payment_status='ok' WHERE f.payment_status='failed'
